english:
Evening Discharge Hymn [Hambartsi] - Tone 3 [gi]: "Along with the oil-bearing women" (Ent kanaysn iughaber). Dismissal Gospel: Mark 4:20-30 ("They came to a house..." to "...is in him").

Wednesday: Morning Hymn Tone 1 [ak]: "Sing to the Lord" (Yergetsek Tyarn). Patristic/Resurrection Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [bdz]: "Today nailed" (Aysor beveryal). Morning Gospel: Luke 7:30-50 ("He was beseeching him..." to "...in peace"). Midday Liturgy Psalm 51 [52] "The fool said", Psalm 53 [54] "Save me, O God, by your name", Psalm 54 [55] "Give ear". Acts 10:24-48 ("And on the morrow..." to "...some days"). Psalm 147:12 [147:12] "Praise the Lord". Catholic [Epistle] of 1 Peter 3:1-9 ("Likewise, you wives..." to "...that you may inherit"). Alleluia, Psalm 64 [65] "Praise is due to you". Gospel: John 4:1-23 ("When therefore [the Lord] knew..." to "...seeks him").

In the Evening: First Gospel: Matthew 9:27-34 ("And as [Jesus] passed by..." to "...he casts out demons"). Messedi: "Your throne", "My heart overflows". Evening Discharge Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [ak]: "The wondrous angel" (Skancheli hreshtakn). Dismissal Gospel: Mark 3:31-35 ("Then came his brethren..." to "...sister and mother").

Thursday: Morning Hymn Tone 2 [bdz]: "Let us bless the Lord" (Orhnesguk uzter). Patristic/Resurrection Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [bdz]: "Who had compassion" (Or gtatsar). Morning Gospel: Luke 8:1-21 ("And it came to pass afterward..." to "...hear and do"). Midday Liturgy Psalm 55 [56] "Be merciful", "Be merciful", "If indeed". Acts 11:1-26 ("And the apostles heard..." to "...Christians"). Psalm 98 [99] "Exalt". Catholic [Epistle] of 1 Peter 3:10-22 ("For he that will..." to "...and powers"). Alleluia, Psalm 14 [15] "Lord, who shall dwell". Gospel: John 4:24-42 ("God is a spirit..." to "...Savior of the world").

In the Evening: First Gospel: Matthew 9:35–10:15 ("And Jesus went about..." to "...that city"). Messedi: "The Lord reigns", "The lightnings shone". Evening Discharge Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 2 [bdz]: "The voice of good tidings" (Dzayn avetavor). Dismissal Gospel: Mark 4:1-9 ("And he began again..." to "...let him hear").

Friday: Morning Hymn Tone 2 [bk]: "Pharaoh with..." (Paravon handerdz). Patristic/Resurrection Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [bdz]: "Who adorned" (Or zardaryal). Morning Gospel: Luke 8:22-56 ("Now it came to pass on a certain day..." to "...what was done"). Midday Liturgy Psalm 58 [59] "Deliver me", "O God, you have rejected us", "Hear, O God". Acts 11:27–12:24 ("And in these days..." to "...grew and multiplied"). Psalm 97 [98] "Have seen all". Catholic [Epistle] of 1 Peter 4:1-11 ("Christ having suffered..." to "...forever, Amen"). Alleluia, Psalm 92 [93] "The Lord reigns". Gospel: John 4:43-54 ("Now after two days..." to "...into Galilee").

In the Evening: First Gospel: Matthew 10:16-40 ("Behold, I send you..." to "...him that sent me"). Messedi: "Sing", "Enter". Evening Discharge Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 2 [bk]: "Holy morning" (Aravotyan surb). Dismissal Gospel: Mark 4:10-20 ("And when he was alone..." to "...one a hundredfold").

Saturday: Morning Hymn Tone 3 [gd]: "Helper" (Ognakan). Patristic/Resurrection Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [bk]: "Who the heavenly host" (Or yerknayin zinvor). Morning Gospel: Luke 9:1-17 ("Then he called..." to "...twelve baskets"). Midday Liturgy Psalm 61 [62] "But only", "O God, my God", "Hear, O God". Acts 12:25–13:15 ("And Barnabas and Saul..." to "...speak on"). Psalm 66 [67] "God be merciful". Catholic [Epistle] of 1 Peter 4:12-19 ("Beloved, think it not strange..." to "...in well doing"). Alleluia, Psalm 6 [6] "Rejoice". Gospel: John 5:1-18 ("After this..." to "...himself with God").

In the Evening: First Gospel: Matthew 11:1-24 ("And it came to pass..." to "...than for you"). Messedi: "Blessed is he who comes", "The Lord our God". Evening Discharge Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [adz]: "Who art highly blessed" (Or verorhnish). Dismissal Gospel: Mark 4:21-25 ("And he said unto them..." to "...from him").

Fourth Sunday: Morning Hymn Tone 3 [gk]: "Sing to the Lord" (Yergetsek tyarn). Patristic/Resurrection Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [bk]: "Without beginning, God" (Anskizbn astuats). Morning Gospel: Luke 9:18-36 ("And it came to pass, as he was alone..." to "...which they had seen"). Midday Liturgy Psalm 64 [65] "Praise is due to you", "Make a joyful noise", "God be merciful". Acts 13:16-43 ("Then Paul stood up..." to "...the grace of God"). Psalm 64 [65] "Praise is due to you". Catholic [Epistle] of 1 Peter 5:1-14 ("The elders which are among you..." to "...in Christ Jesus, Amen"). Alleluia, Psalm 147:12 [147] "Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem". Gospel: John 5:19-30 ("Then answered [Jesus]..." to "...who sent me").

In the Evening: First Gospel: Matthew 11:25-30 ("At that time..." to "...light [humble of heart]"). And they shall go out with the cross and the Gospel.
